subject: Moving Graphics out of plot builder

messages.author: 36a7cb8f6d90c718
messages.subject: Moving Graphics out of plot builder
parts:
Hello,

I have created a graphic in the Deducer plot builder. I would now like to save it as a jpg (or similar graphic file) and put it into a word document, but I am having trouble figuring out how to do this. 

Any hints?

messages.author: 4f782baffe1b9d1a
messages.subject: Re: Moving Graphics out of plot builder
parts:
If you click "Run", it should put the plot into a graphics window that has a File menu with several formats available. 

Sent from my iPod
